# Time Mapping

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TimeMapping`](gmeow-TimeMapping.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TimeMapping>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A declared mapping between two musical time frames or spans. Tuplets, tempo canons, and tempo maps are kinds of [`TimeMapping`](gmeow-TimeMapping.md); their arithmetic is solver-evaluated, never reasoner-asserted. [`MetricModulation`](gmeow-MetricModulation.md) and [`GrooveProfile`](gmeow-GrooveProfile.md) are modeled as separate constructs (Principles 4, 12).
